quizGuardRationale: Direct symmetric nontransitive hypotheses, not independent findings or a live runtime guarantee. Read actual titles, complete old bodies and ordinary secondary senses for both excesses and omissions.

造る reuse: actual building/manufacturing overlaps, not spelling-based cliques. The old造船 declaration already guards作る. Dictionary-only建造 has no fabricated article. Added着ける wearing/alongside and explicit点ける recognition require sense-sensitive comparisons.

伝わる transmission/spreading/communication differs in grammar from deliberate伝える but shares defensible translations. 突っ込む shoving/plunging/collision/probing senses vary in transitivity; a force/depth image is not a universal accident claim.

務める/勤める dictionary serve-as overlap is not erased by the role/employment teaching contrast. 努める concerns effort, not the erroneous employment gloss; noun roles/tasks do not automatically become every role-performing verb.
綱/縄 have an identical title and already deduplicate. Actual cord/line labels may overlap; connection nouns and connecting verbs require separate direct judgments rather than transitive closure.

潰す/潰れる ordinary crushing, breaking, business/plan failure, wasted talent/time and functional loss deserve sense-sensitive checks, not every destruction verb indiscriminately. Time filling need not be regrettable waste.
つまずく need not include falling, while ordinary figurative setback overlaps failure. 詰まる includes packed/clogged, shortening and verbal impasse, not only crowds.

爪/釘 differ in referent but English nail creates ambiguity. 艶 concerns gloss/luster and extended appeal; つるつる includes an actual shine sense, while illumination光 is not automatically the same surface quality.
